description: All contract rows of one supplier with the buying office's contact, end dates and amounts. Needs an Enterprise Data key: X-API-Key header on the MCP request (https://assay-systems.com/api-key/#data).

country.description: Two-letter country code in lower case, e.g. ca, us, gb, ua. assay_countries lists them.

ends_before.description: YYYY-MM-DD: only contracts ending before this day.

id.description: Record id as given by assay_search (the part after the country in the endpoint).

name: assay_supplier_contracts
title: Supplier's contract rows
